title: Before any vote, a list
subject: politics
native_material: the Election Commission's own press note, voter-roll data, the newspaper report, the opposition's demand
hook_mechanism: open on the Commission's own press note at the end of the story, then rewind to how 13 crore names left the rolls

pick.owner_words: "now give sample video of 1 minutes on current indian politics and 1 minute video on american politics. lets see what we have learnt. again freehand." (the owner delegated the topic and the pick; live-viewer-trap excluded as the last film's engine)

concept.logline: India's voter-roll revision removed about 13 crore names from draft rolls; the Commission says it is cleaning the list, the opposition says voters are being lost.
concept.central_question: How did India's voter lists lose 13 crore names, and who says what about it?
concept.claim: The SIR removed about 13.3 crore draft-roll entries (mostly marked absent or shifted); critics and two commissioners objected; the Commission answers with camps and Form 6.

thumbnail: Statement: Before any vote, there is a *list*.

scenes.narration: Nothing like it since two thousand two.

scenes.narration: About seventy-one percent were marked absent or shifted.

scenes.narration: About 2.8 crore had died. About one crore were duplicates.
Then The Indian Express reported dissent inside the Commission.
scenes.graphic: Clipping: 14 times in 10 months, two Election Commissioners objected on record to poll panel steps | The Indian Express, September 2026 | newspaper

scenes.narration: Two commissioners, it said, objected on record fourteen times.

scenes.narration: The Commission says its key decisions were unanimous.

scenes.narration: The Congress wants every deleted name restored.
